thread:
amy: Quick sprint drop  we need final micro-variants for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing cards + one-line social benchmark teaser (no numbers) + clear webinar routing rules. Tradeoffs doc due TOM.

josh: Tone notes: Hosted = fast/experimental, Dedicated = production predictable, Private = locked-down & trusted. Keep CTAs ~2 words.

priya: Draft A (short heroes + subheads + CTAs):
- Hosted: "Launch faster with Hosted API"  "From prototype to production in hours."  CTA: "Launch Hosted"
- Dedicated: "Capacity Pools (Dedicated)"  "Throughput and SLOs for steady production."  CTA: "Book capacity"
- Private: "Onsite & VPC installs"  "Enterprise controls: KMS, on-prem, audited runs."  CTA: "Request install"

zach: Draft B (alternate wording):
- Hosted alt: "Hosted API for builders"  "Spin up models, ship features faster."  CTA: "Try Hosted"
- Dedicated alt: "Reserved GPU pools"  "Predictable latency, cost-optimized for scale."  CTA: "Reserve pool"
- Private alt: "Private installs"  "Keep sensitive data in your network."  CTA: "Contact sales"

priya: Social-safe benchmark teaser options (pick one):
- "Register for a live demo + throughput & cost walkthrough across our deployment modes."
- "See side-by-side demo and performance tradeoffs  Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private."
- "Live session: demo, benchmarks, and routing guidance for production infra."

amy: Webinar format we settled on: 45m total (25m demo, 10m benchmark walkthrough, 10m live Q&A). Reg page needs primary CTA (Register) and secondary for AE requests for Dedicated/Private.

josh: Inbound routing rules (HubSpot pseudo snippet). Use these form names: hosted_trial_form, capacity_pool_request_form, private_install_form.
``` 
# HubSpot workflow pseudo
if form.name == "hosted_trial_form":
  set lifecycle = "MQL"
  owner = "marketing"
  add_hidden utm_campaign=prod_launch_05

if form.name == "capacity_pool_request_form":
  assign.owner = "AE_pool"
  tag = "dedicated_inquiry"
  notify = "ae-team@redwood.com"

if form.name == "private_install_form":
  assign.owner = "Enterprise_SDR"
  priority = "high"
  notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood.com"
```

priya: Also add hidden field utm_source=social and campaign utm_campaign=prod_launch_05. For Dedicated we should also add a hidden field `expected_qps` to help AE prioritization.

zach: Microcopy for reg confirmation email: "Thanks for registering  calendar invite sent. Want a Dedicated or Private follow-up? Select the checkbox in the confirmation and we'll route you to an AE."

bot-deploy: Calendar created: Webinar "Deployment modes: demo + benchmarks" 2025-05-14 15:00 UTC. Speakers: @amy @priya @zach :calendar:

amy: Next steps: Josh  pick the primary hero per mode (A or B) and drop into the launch doc. Priya  pick the social teaser and format for LinkedIn/X. Zach  hand the HubSpot pseudo to ops and request final workflow IDs. I'll assemble and send to design. Thanks :rocket:
